item.title: Fox Corp. seeks to move Mark Sanchez lawsuit to federal court
item.description: Fox Corporation has filed a motion to move a lawsuit stemming from former NFL quarterback Mark Sanchez's downtown Indianapolis fight to federal court, claiming that Sanchez and Fox are both out-of-state defendants and that Huse Culinary was fraudulently joined to the lawsuit to prevent the case from moving to federal court.

item.title: 13-year-old girl dies in accidental Christmas Day shooting by 15-year-old
item.description: A 15-year-old boy has been charged with manslaughter after a 13-year-old girl was fatally shot on Christmas Day, according to the Orange County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Insurance navigator: Health insurance subsidies still available in 2026
item.description: Despite the end of expanded Affordable Care Act subsidies, people will still be able to receive health insurance assistance through the original ACA subsidies, and open enrollment for February is still available.

item.title: IMPD: Domestic violence calls surge during holidays
item.description: IMPD reports a rise in domestic violence calls around the holidays, and officers are urged to be on high alert as these situations can quickly escalate and victims may be afraid to speak up.
